Initial release of product-design-workflow providing a rapid, end-to-end product design process.

- Generates 3 product ideas daily, each tagged by topic (market trends, A-shares, funds) and audience type (beginner-friendly or general).
- Produces full PRD documents and HTML prototype pages for each idea.
- Includes scripts for automation: idea generation, rule checking, workflow execution, and server uploading.
- Enforces strict content, tagging, and template usage rules.
- Demo prototypes can be uploaded to a preset server with one-click scripts.
- Bundles detailed templates and workflow guides for standardization.
